name: Yamashiro Akari
source: The protagonist's childhood friend and and student council president, she has earned the trust of both students and teachers. With the new business philosophy, in a very short time she became the daughter of the president of a large enterprise. Her parents adopted the orphan protagonist so their relationship is like that of siblings, and so she can be overprotective because she loves him so much.
